data.text/markdown: Optimal cut-off of glucose level for predicting diabetes

This notebook shows how to use cutpointpy for estimating the optimal cut-off value of plasma glucose concentration at two hours in an oral glucose tolerance test (GTIT) to predict diabetes mellitus. The data come from the Pima Indians Diabetes Database, available on Kaggle (CC0: Public Domain).
